tokenomics: The Q network is stabilized by sophisticated economics that distribute token rewards through different pools and proxies to the according reward earner
purge-slashing: In order to slash the same validator again, root node needs to purge all his slashing transactions
lock-tokens-for-voting: Lock the number of tokens that you plan to vote with (the number of locked tokens will set your voting weight)
liquidation-auction: Borrowing vault is free for liquidation due to price fluctuation of collateralized assets
system-debt: System dept overpasses the threshold and netting is not possible
system-surplus: System surplus overpasses the threshold and netting is not possible
